name: Mule
overview: Scripture presents mules as valuable and versatile animals used in various significant roles, including as pack animals and for riding by royalty, as seen in 1 Kings 10:25 and Isaiah 66:20. They were integral to trade and tribute, evidenced by their mention alongside horses in commerce and offerings (Ezekiel 27:14; 1 Kings 10:25). The captivity returning from Babylon also utilized mules, highlighting their practical importance in transportation and war (Ezra 2:66; Nehemiah 7:68; Zechariah 14:15). Furthermore, prophetic visions of the kingdom of Christ include mules, underscoring their symbolic and functional place in God's unfolding plan.
